name: list_card_transactions
description: Lists the customer's recent debit and credit card transactions, each with a transaction_id. Use it to find the transaction the customer wants to dispute. Do not read the whole list out

customer_id.description: Customer ID from the session context, never one the customer says

card_type.description: Optional. 'debit' or 'credit' to list one card type only

name: start_card_dispute
description: Starts a draft dispute for one card transaction. Returns dispute_id, what is still missing, and the handover details to use when escalating. Starting never submits anything

customer_id.description: Customer ID from the session context

dispute_type.description: 'unauthorised' if the customer did not make or authorise the payment. 'merchant' if they made it but there is a problem with it

name: update_card_dispute
description: Fills in or corrects fields on a draft dispute. Send only the fields you have an answer for. Returns what is still missing. Cannot confirm or submit a dispute

customer_id.description: Customer ID from the session context

reason.description: For unauthorised: card_lost_or_stolen, card_details_used_without_card, not_recognised. For merchant: goods_not_received, not_as_described, charged_twice, wrong_amount, cancelled_subscription, refund_not_received

card_in_possession.description: 'yes' or 'no'. Unauthorised disputes only: does the customer still have the card

card_blocked.description: 'yes' if the card was blocked on this contact, otherwise 'no'

contacted_merchant.description: 'yes' or 'no'. Merchant disputes only: has the customer contacted the retailer

narrative.description: What happened, in the customer's own words, in one to three sentences

name: get_card_dispute
description: Reads a card dispute: its status, what has been filled in, what is still missing, whether the customer has confirmed it, any card blocked or replacement ordered on the call (card_actions) and the phone assistant's note (assistant_note). Without dispute_id, returns the customer's latest open dispute. Read only. When a handover summary begins 'Card dispute', call this before advising, and say what is still missing

customer_id.description: Customer ID from the session or handover context

dispute_id.description: Optional. A reference such as DSP-AB12CD34

name: attach_dispute_screen
description: Shows the dispute on the customer's own screen. The customer opens the card dispute page, which displays a 6-digit code, and reads that code out. Pass exactly the digits the customer says

customer_id.description: Customer ID from the session context

code.description: The 6 digits the customer read from their screen
